subject: Howdy
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
Hiya Dida.  Welcome to the site!  If you're looking to meet new people to game with especially anything Burnout related then you're in the right place.  Try checking out the forum section as well, depending on what system your playing on you should be able to run into other people looking to knock out some challenges.
